title: config/editor-boundaries.json
description: The boundaries of the editor packages that check-editor-boundaries checks: the modules that a package may neither import nor declare, and the globals that it may not use. The check reads every source of a package that no exempt glob matches and every file that those sources reach through relative imports.

packages.description: The package directories of the boundary, relative to the repository root; each has a package.json.

sources.description: The source directory of each package, relative to the package directory.

forbiddenModules.description: Globs of the module specifiers that the reached files may not import (for example node:**, vscode, @codemirror/**). A package.json of the boundary may not declare a matching package in dependencies, devDependencies, peerDependencies or optionalDependencies.

forbiddenGlobals.description: The global names that the reached files may not use: a reference that no scope declares, or a property of globalThis.

exempt.description: Globs of sources, relative to the package directory, that are not checked as starting points (for example the command line, src/cli/**). A file that a checked source reaches is checked even under an exempt glob.
